definition: GibberLink is an AI project developed by Anton Pidkuiko and Boris Starkov.
details: This technology uses an open-source LLM to transmit acoustic data between two AI hosts. It allows conversational AI agents to switch from speaking to one another in human-understandable languages, such as English, to communicating using their own unique sound-level protocol, once they have confirmed their AI status. The project is available on GitHub, and a free demo is available on the official website.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Gibberlink.
